scientific_integrity: Source texts are attributed, calculations are reproducible with embedded standalone programs and observed outputs, and independent external validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only the four fixed inner jumps k=4,5,6,7 are classified. The exact infinite-n proof uses exhaustive finite-state component calculations plus a mathematical bijection, not a wholly handwritten SCC enumeration. No statement is made for arbitrary jump, merely disconnected perfect matchings, or historical priority beyond the sources searched. Some isolated small-parameter cases are covered by graph isomorphisms to earlier studied families.
title: Rigidity and two resonance periods for perfect matching cuts at Petersen steps \(4\)–\(7\)
